LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.priceHotTub.Desc: What a guest pays for one soak in a hot tub. Multiplied by the venue's price factor.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.priceSauna.Desc: What a guest pays for one sauna session.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.priceMassage.Desc: What a guest pays for one massage. Only given when a colonist with the Serving work type is free to give it.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.dayPass.Desc: Wealthier guests buy a day pass instead of paying per session. It covers hot tub and sauna, not massage.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.priceDayPass.Desc: Price of the spa day pass (hot tub and sauna for the pass duration).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.dayPassHours.Desc: How long a day pass stays valid.
Price reduction when nobody on staff is in the room. A colonist with the Serving work type standing in the room counts as staff.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.hoursSauna.Desc: How long one sauna session lasts.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.hoursMassage.Desc: How long one massage lasts. Both masseur and client are busy that long.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.massageWaitHours.Des: How long someone lies on the table waiting for a masseur before giving up.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.saunaMinTemp.Desc: A sauna stove only counts as a working sauna when its room is at least this warm.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.joyFactor.Desc: Multiplier on the recreation colonists get from hot tub, sauna and massage.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.restBonus.Desc: Share of the rest bar restored by a session (a little more for a massage). Set 0 for none.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.soothe.Desc: A session leaves the pawn soothed for about a day: pain is felt 15 % less.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.massageXp.Desc: Social and Medicine experience the masseur earns for a full massage.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.satisfaction.Desc: How much a finished session raises a guest's satisfaction (scale -1 to +1).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.guestWeight.Desc: How strongly guests want the spa compared to other activities. 0 = they never go.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.guestCooldownHours.D: A guest does not start another spa session sooner than this.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.wellness.rehabJoy.Desc: With RimWard active, walking patients in a colony medical bed may visit hot tub, sauna and massage table for recreation (never the sauna after surgery or with open wounds).
LanguageData.HH.Wellness.Inspect.SaunaNotReady: Not a working sauna yet: {0} °C of {1} °C needed ({2}).
LanguageData.HH.Wellness.Inspect.MassageWaiting: Someone is waiting for a masseur.
LanguageData.HH.Wellness.Inspect.Users: Colonists may use: {0}. Guests may use: {1}.
LanguageData.HH.Wellness.Gizmo.ColonistsDesc: Allow colonists to use this for recreation. Turn off while the spa is open for business.
LanguageData.HH.Wellness.Gizmo.GuestsDesc: Allow guests to use this (they pay when it stands in a spa venue).
